title: CaveEraser
description: Detect and fill underwater caves for bedrock flattening
body:
# CaveEraser - Water Cave Detection & Filling

Streamline your bedrock flattening work! Automatically detect and fill underwater caves.

## Features

- **Cave Scanning** - Auto-detect underwater caves
- **Cave Filling** - Fill with configurable blocks
- **Chunk Fill** - Bulk convert water/lava/air
- **Async Processing** - Maintain TPS
- **EmeraldBank Integration** - Optional cost system

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/ce scan [radius]` | Scan for caves |
| `/ce list` | List detected caves |
| `/ce fill <ID> [block]` | Fill a cave |
| `/ce auto [radius] [block]` | Auto fill all |
| `/ce chunkfill [radius] [block]` | Fill chunk |
| `/ce reload` | Reload config |

## Permissions

**⚠️ OP alone is NOT enough!**

| Permission | Default |
|------------|---------|
| `caveeraser.*` | false |
| `caveeraser.scan` | false |
| `caveeraser.fill` | false |
| `caveeraser.chunkfill` | false |

## Detection Limits

- Max Volume: 100,000 blocks
- Min Water: 1 block
- Y Range: -64 to 320

## Requirements

- Spigot/Paper 1.21.x
- Java 17+
- EmeraldBank (Optional)
